name: AI Vision — Intelligent OCR & Image Analysis
description: An AI-powered React Native application that turns captured images into meaningful, structured information through camera capture, image selection, Supabase-backed analysis, and a dynamic results experience.
role: Built the mobile product surface with TypeScript, Expo, camera and image workflows, navigation, hooks, interactive loading/result states, and the integration path to Supabase-backed AI image analysis.
challenge: Make an image-analysis workflow feel immediate and understandable across capture, gallery selection, remote analysis, structured response handling, and error states.
note: Source-led presentation. No unverified screenshots or performance claims are included.

name: Adaptive Exercise Recognition - Personalized ML Case Study
description: An AI-powered adaptive exercise recognition system for Vantage Fit that evolved from pose-landmark movement tracking and rule-based squat detection into a validation-gated TensorFlow Lite classifier with anti-cheat logic and a personalization feedback loop.
role: Designed exercise-recognition logic on top of existing pose landmarks, used background session recordings during testing to understand real user behavior, introduced environmental and sensor validation, migrated deterministic recognition to ML, and shaped the personalization architecture.
challenge: Real users found ways to game the detector by lying down, changing phone orientation, exercising in poor lighting, and showing prerecorded squat videos, forcing the system to evolve through independent validation gates instead of relying on one computer-vision decision.
note: Conceptual architecture only. This portfolio avoids proprietary source code, sensitive anti-cheat implementation details, and unprovided performance metrics.

name: Tapori AI - Android, React Native & Flutter AI Chat Application
type: Android + React Native + Flutter / AI Chat
description: An AI-powered conversational mobile application with contextual chat, authentication, credit management, payments, Supabase Edge Functions, and LLM integration. Originally built natively for Android and later migrated to Flutter while preserving Clean Architecture and backend contracts.
role: Built the native Android foundation and migrated the client to Flutter while preserving product behavior, architecture boundaries, and backend contracts.
challenge: Keep authentication, credits, HTTP 402 handling, payment flow, and API contracts stable while moving from native Android patterns to Flutter, Riverpod, Dio, and GoRouter.
note: Flutter implementation: master-flutter branch. The Play Store listing is preserved without implying the Flutter client is the current production Play Store build.
